newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India sells Oct 25,000/t NGL to Swiss trader.
newsitem.headline: India sells Oct 25,000/t NGL to Swiss trader.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has sold through a tender 25,000 tonnes of natural gas liquids (NGL) to a Swiss trader at $40.00 per tonne below spot Mediterranean quotes on a free-on-board basis (fob), traders said Monday.
IOC offered 25,000 tonnes of NGL lifting from Hazira, on the west coast, between October 14-16. The tender closed on October 2 and offers were valid until October 4.
Dutch trader Vitol won the last Hazira tender at $34 per tonne below Mediterrenean quotes on a fob basis, lifting September 14-16.
